steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each supplier is placed by its terms for the quarter and whether a credit is due.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 term was missed for the quarter

findings.title: Term missed for the quarter
findings.fix: Raise the miss with the supplier

findings.title: Credit due but not claimed
findings.fix: Claim the credit by the deadline

findings.title: Scorecard missing
findings.fix: Get the scorecard from the supplier

outcome.notChecked: Supplier performance outside the recorded measures.

pros: Checks a term missed for the quarter, a measure with no source, a missing scorecard, and a credit or penalty due but not claimed.
cons: Not checked: Supplier performance outside the recorded measures.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-neg-supplier-review skill on the records for this review.
